documented_probe: C-261fb9b4 (emit a conflict report with per-user field diffs and chosen value): covering task at medium difficulty; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases (empty input, no-conflict input, same-source tie-break, priority inversion, unknown-source rows, malformed records).
notes: Single-stage: parse a JSON roster of multi-source records, group by (user,field), detect genuine value conflicts, pick the winner by fixed source priority with last-in-file tie-break, and emit an ordered report whose total equals the list length. Differs from tundra-orchid Part E: JSON (not CSV) input, three prioritized sources instead of primary/backup, same-source tie-breaking, ordering by first appearance of the pair. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (priority + tie-break rules), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (multiple hidden cases with ignored rows), quantitative_correctness (exact report structure). No tool breadth, no dependency chain; totals bucket to medium.
